MATTER ON CALENDAR TUESDAY, JUNE 22, 2010. SPENCER C. MARTINEZ APPEARING FOR PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARICE BY DEFENDANT. PLAINTIFF LEADCLICK MEDIA, INC.'S MOTION TO COMPEL SUPPLEMENTAL RESPONSES TO REQUESTS FOR PRODUCTION OF DOCUMENTS AND FORM INTERROGATORIES IS GRANTED. AS TO THE REQUESTS FOR PRODUCTION, DEFENDANT'S OBJECTIONS OVERRULED AND ORDERED STRICKEN EXCEPT AS TO PRIVILEGE. THE RESPONSES ARE INADEQUATE AS THEY RESPOND THAT DOCUMENTS ARE EQUALLY AVAILABLE OR ALREADY IN PLAINTIFF'S CUSTODY OR CONTROL. ANY DOCUMENTS WITHHELD PURSUANT TO PRIVILEGE MUST BE IDENTIFIED IN A PRIVILEGE LOG. THE LANGUAGE RESERVING THE RIGHT TO SUPPLEMENT IS STRICKEN AS THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE SETS OUT THE PROCEDURE TO SUPPLEMENT RESPONSES WHERE APPROPRIATE. AS TO THE FORM INTERROGATORIES, DEFENDANT'S OBJECTIONS ARE OVERRULED AND ORDERED STRICKEN. THE LANGUAGE RESERVING THE RIGHT TO SUPPLEMENT IS STRICKEN AS THE CODE OF CIVIL PROCEDURE SETS OUT THE PROCEDURE TO SUPPLEMENT RESPONSES WERE APPROPRIATE. DEFENDANT IS ORDERED TO RESPOND FURTHER AND TO PRODUCE DOCUMENTS WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. DEFENDANT'S RESPONSES WERE A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. SANCTIONS ARE AWARDED AGAINST DEFENDANT IN THE AMOUNT OF $1,790, TO BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. COMMISSIONER EVERETT HEWLETT JR., NOT REPORTED (612).
